name: Denoising using Marcenko-Pastur PCA (MP-PCA)
summary: Denoises DWI with Marcenko-Pastur PCA (MP-PCA) using the DIPY 1.1.1 dipy_denoise_mppca workflow and outputs the denoised DWI with its bvals and bvecs.
description: Wraps DIPY's dipy_denoise_mppca, which removes thermal noise from diffusion-weighted data by local PCA with a Marcenko-Pastur threshold over patches of a given radius. Use it as an early DWI preprocessing step, before motion and distortion correction. The bvals and bvecs are copied unchanged to the output.

inputs.description: 4D diffusion-weighted image with bvals and bvecs.

outputs.description: MP-PCA denoised DWI (dwi.nii.gz) with the original bvals and bvecs.

parameters.description:
The radius of the local patch to be taken around each voxel (in
            voxels)

Use either eigenvalue decomposition ('eig') or singular value decomposition ('svd') for principal component analysis. The default method is 'eig' which is faster. However, occasionally 'svd' might be more accurate.

citations.text: Garyfallidis E. et al. Dipy, a library for the analysis of diffusion MRI data. Frontiers in Neuroinformatics 8, 8 (2014).
Avesani P. et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).
